result.summary: Found 1 issue: the bottom navigation Orders tab appears to be missing its icon while other tabs have icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows labels for Home, Search, Orders, and Profile, but the Orders tab has no visible icon above its label, unlike the other tabs.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate Orders/receipt icon aligned with the other tab icons, or verify the icon asset is loading and not transparent/misaligned.
